summary: ProjectManager.get_status hydrates #634 durable spend via get_budget_snapshot(base_dir=budget_base_dir) so isolated PM runs honor configured budget rails instead of operator .agentic/budget/spend.json.
migration_impact: No downstream config change. Callers that construct ProjectManager(budget_base_dir=...) now get matching status/pressure for run_cycle budget pauses.
agent_notes: When testing or running PM under an isolated root, pass budget_base_dir (typically root/budget) so get_status and budget gates do not read the operator spend file.
